title: The Map
summary: See where everyone is in the running campaign.

sections.heading: Before you start
steps: The Map works while the server is running. Press Start server first.
Coodsz Coop Server Tool adds its own server tools on every Start. The Map reads the campaign through them.
Nothing on the Map changes the game. It only shows what the server says.

sections.heading: What you see
steps: The land is the real campaign map, read from the server once each time it starts.
Towns, castles and villages have the colour of their kingdom. A red circle is a battle or a siege.
Every player is always on the map. Army leaders and other lords show when their box is ticked.
The Map reads the parties every few seconds while the page is open. Read now reads it right away.
sections.tip: Until the land is read, the map is plain parchment. The towns and kingdoms are still there.

sections.heading: Layers and moving around
steps: Tick or untick Towns, Castles, Villages, Armies, Lords and Territory above the map.
Press Kingdoms to see each kingdom's colour and what the marks mean.
Use the mouse wheel or the + and − buttons to zoom. Drag the map to move it.
Names show up as you zoom in. Player names always show.

sections.heading: Finding someone
steps: Type a player, lord or settlement in the search box and pick it. The map goes there.
The Players list on the side says what each player is doing and how many troops they have.
Click a party or a settlement for its card. It has Centre the map, Open profile and Open in Encyclopedia.

sections.heading: Show on map
steps: In a player profile, press Show on map to jump to that player's party.
In the Encyclopedia, press Show on map on a hero or a settlement.
A hero with no party right now, like a prisoner, cannot be shown.
sections.tip: Streamer mode shows players as Player 1, Player 2 on the map, so you can stream it.
